--- header_pre ---
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
  // Eye-space light positions, set before the camera transform.
  glLightfv(GL_LIGHT0, GL_POSITION, repl_glfloat4(0, 0, -1, 1));
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -6.0000f);
  glRotatef(10.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(15.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.0000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  glClear(GL_COLOR_BUFFER_BIT | GL_DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, GL_TRUE);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 30);

  glClearColor(0.05, 0.06, 0.08, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT3);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glFrontFace(GL_CW);
  // Arrow shape - concave, tessellated with per-vertex color
  gluBegin(GLU_POLYGON);
    gluBegin(GLU_CONTOUR);
      gluNormal(0, 0, 1);
      gluColor(0.15, 0.55, 1, 1);
      gluVertex(-1.2, -0.45, 0);
      gluColor(0.15, 0.55, 1, 1);
      gluVertex(-1.2, 0.45, 0);
      gluColor(0.55, 0.3, 1, 1);
      gluVertex(0, 0.45, 0);
      gluColor(1, 0.35, 0.2, 1);
      gluVertex(0, 1.1, 0);
      gluColor(1, 0.85, 0.15, 1);
      gluVertex(1.3, 0, 0);
      gluColor(1, 0.35, 0.2, 1);
      gluVertex(0, -1.1, 0);
      gluColor(0.55, 0.3, 1, 1);
      gluVertex(0, -0.45, 0);
    gluEnd();
  gluEnd();
